Q-FLOW28-PF —
cryptography in hardware.

A programmable post-quantum cryptography fabric architecture for a TSMC 28 nm target.

PQC · APB4 · AXI4Architecture work · not fabricated

02 / Resource plan

Design intent

Explore a shared hardware platform for post-quantum cryptographic algorithms, with secure control and data movement. This project is at the architecture stage; listed blocks are design scope, not completed or measured silicon.

Architecture scope

  • Shared NTT/INTT resources and polynomial arithmetic.
  • Keccak-f[1600] support.
  • Dedicated X25519 datapath.
  • ML-KEM-512/768/1024 and ML-DSA-44/65/87 algorithm targets.

System interfaces and security blocks

APB4 control, AXI4 data movement, secure scratchpad, key vault, TRNG/DRBG and a security controller are in the architectural plan.

Target: TSMC 28 nm. There is no tapeout result or silicon performance claim on this page.

Work needed before implementation claims

Freeze the supported algorithm parameter sets, define the threat model and security boundaries, quantify shared-resource scheduling and memory traffic, then verify functional correctness and constant-time behavior before physical design.
